title: Atmospheric mercury concentration variations at Syowa Station, Lützow-Holm Bay, East Antarctica and contributing factors
content:

Koyomi Nakazawa, Osamu Nagafuchi, Akihiro Mitsui, Tomoaki Watanabe, Naoko Hishida, Megumu Tsujimoto, Satoshi Imura
In January 2022, gaseous elemental Hg (GEM) concentrations were continuously monitored at Syowa Station on East Ongul Island, located ∼4 km from the continent on the eastern coast of Lützow-Holm Bay in the Antarctic region.
